inputs.text: [excited] ed… MON… toh… SOR… us. [curious] His name comes from Edmonton, a city in Canada where his bones were found. And "saurus" is Greek for lizard.
[happily] Exactly. [warmly] He lived in North America, sixty-eight million years ago — at the same time as Triceratops.
[playful] Thousands. [amazed] Enormous herds. And T. rex watched them, patiently.
